action: clear Android bootloader control block in MISC to restore the normal BOOT path
reason: A boot-recovery command left in the Android BCB routes every normal boot to RECOVERY. RECOVERY holds a UniXNU MMU/console probe image that resets on its own timer and never consumes the command, so the tablet could not reach One UI.
notes: Same clean-MISC image and Heimdall end behavior as the 2026-11-11 and 2026-11-08 clears. The device remained in download mode after the upload (--no-reboot), so a manual force reboot is required. adb reboot recovery re-arms the BCB; with a UniXNU Recovery image it must be cleared again.
